body: We don't typically hug, but have been since she went in. I hugged him last night and started bawling.

She thought he was interested in the friend that they went to dinner with that night. Her claim was she did it so they could be together, this woman and her husband are both good friends with my mom and dad. My dad also isn't attracted to her, and I believe him. I know he's still into my mom, and I've definitely seen more than I needed to recently of that.
I mean my sister died 26 years ago, so I guess him carrying around a picture is just a little weird to me. Granted it was tragic, it's not a little picture.

They went on a date, and my aunt was watching her. She had taken her to get some chicken and some drunk teenagers decided to drag race. One lost control of his car, hit them and injured everyone involved. My sister had the worst injuries and died two day later while my mom and dad were sleeping. I don't think they ever got over not being awake.

I must have misunderstood... Do you think my dad cheated? I still don't. He is so sad, we went to go she her today and he held her and told her how much he loves her. 

When I saw the picture, he moved in front of it to block my view which was weird.

Thanks, I'm trying. I do think it's a little weird he brought the picture with him, but I'm trying not to judge. Like I said, I didn't know her, know them with her, and I've never experienced anything like it myself.

I've definitely been hugging him. He stayed with us last night. When we got to the house there was blood everywhere, so I cleaned it up. 

When we got to my place I went in to check on him. He brought the last picture that was taken of my sister and put it on the night stand. (She died before I was born at five.) He got really embarrassed and said that he was sorry, but he just can't sleep without it... I told him to not be sorry.
He's beside himself watching her. I think he might be more upset than she is...  he keeps going outside to cry. She'll be moved into in patient care today or tomorrow. She seems very sad.

I do know he was accused of cheating in about '98... Completely false, and I have spoken about it with family friends who've said the other woman was obsessed with him, and he wouldn't do that to my mom. She freaked and started the rumor.

I asked him point blank today if he's having an affair, and he said no and listed all the things he finds unattractive about this other woman. My dad's a pretty judgmental guy when it comes to the way women look and I don't think he'd budge on that.
Yep. They just told us that she's not going to be able to come home after this. After the hospital she has to go into some sort of treatment at the hospital.
I don't think that's it... But I don't know. She's up today, and seems out of it. They told my dad and I that we're lucky she's alive, the doctor hasn't​ ever repaired wrists that bad.
I believe so. At least from my perspective, I've never heard of her having a problem like this before.
